title: Failed skill checks that are retryable (e.g. persuading Regent Ysolde with the founding ledger) can simply be re-attempted immediately with identical odds until they succeed, at the cost of a turn but no other stakes, which undercuts tension on an otherwise dramatic beat.
where: Regent's Chambers / 'the founding ledger' will check
